opening: The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply.
The pain gets worse when I move.
I have cancer that has spread (metastatic cancer).
I drink too much alcohol or I'm addicted to it.

opening.text: The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply, and it also gets worse when I move. I have a cough with intense coughing fits. I have cancer that has spread, I'm being treated for osteoporosis, and I drink too much alcohol or I'm addicted to it.
